required_inputs.description: approved change and sponsor; affected agent/human roles; readiness, communication and adoption evidence

expected_outputs.description: stakeholder/readiness assessment; adoption and training plan; measured effectiveness review

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Identify process, organizational, strategic or culture change, sponsor, honest purpose, affected people/agents and available evidence. Inventory concurrent changes, absorption, workload and ability to pause; diagnose fatigue before proposing another rollout.

Use ADKAR as an evidence-labeled diagnostic: awareness of why, desire/concerns, knowledge of how, ability/time/tools/support and reinforcement. Separate perception from observed behavior and flag missing evidence.

Diagnose vocal and silent resistance, valid objections, timing, lack of consultation, trust and capacity. Adapt the change when objections expose a real defect; do not treat resistance as a personality failure or assume silence is agreement.

Choose interventions for the diagnosed gap and change type: sponsor explanation, participation, targeted training, protected practice time, support and sustained reinforcement. Coordinate communication with its distinct skill and technical implementation with Eric; upstream timelines/thresholds are illustrative only.

Define adoption, usage, reversion, satisfaction, support and outcome measurements with baseline, period, owner and agreed criteria. Distinguish compliance under observation from sustained adoption; record lessons and authorized next actions without independently removing systems or imposing policy.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated
